joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture irrational human diversity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型无法捕捉非理性的人类多样性。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性；其价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key to making life multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是实现多行星生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: AI 安全需要监管监督；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更计算高效。

elon.en: Neuralink aims to solve neurological issues and enable high-bandwidth human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: Neuralink 旨在解决神经问题，并实现高带宽的人机共生。

elon.en: AI could surpass human intelligence soon; truth-seeking is crucial for safety; humanoid robots will be transformative.
elon.zh: AI 可能很快超越人类智能；追求真理对安全至关重要；人形机器人将具有变革性。

elon.en: AI and robotics will create abundance; space-based data centers and universal high income are inevitable.
elon.zh: AI 和机器人将创造富足；太空数据中心和普遍高收入不可避免。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for AI progress.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 存在局限；架构而非缩放定律是 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is inefficient; better learning algorithms will emerge, and end-to-end optimization is necessary.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：强化学习效率低下；更好的学习算法将出现，端到端优化是必要的。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit; human notions of right and wrong evolve over time.
tworek.zh: 始终：对齐是永无止境的追求；人类对是非的观念随时间演变。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心；Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive next-token prediction to interleaving action-taking in environments; inference becomes dominant power consumer; agents handle long tasks.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非被动下一个词预测；推理成为算力主要消耗；智能体可自主处理长任务。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; focus on automating ML/science loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups target failures.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力；强调自动化 ML 和科学实验循环；上下文工程和专用推理硬件至关重要；创业应瞄准前沿模型完全失败的领域。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码而非石油；用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; no US-China research gap.
awang.zh: 用专门数据后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美中研究差距不存在。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: AI 是集中化技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; safety and selective open-sourcing critical.
awang.zh: 递归自我改进标志新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近；安全与选择性开源至关重要。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，以支持 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; AGI is more marketing than science.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为 AI 需超越 Scaling（规模扩张），发展创造力、抽象和情商；AGI（通用人工智能）更多是营销术语。

feifei.en: Transformers natively model sets, not sequences; spatial intelligence captures embodied interaction that language cannot.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她指出 Transformer 本质建模集合而非序列，空间智能捕捉语言无法表达的具身体验。

feifei.en: AI augments human capability, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key, with spatial intelligence central.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，主动性和适应是关键，空间智能仍是核心。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment helps society adapt; alignment boosts capability.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署帮助社会适应；对齐提升能力。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; governance and board structures are crucial for AGI development.
altman.zh: 算力是最宝贵的资源；治理和董事会结构对 AGI 发展至关重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is bottleneck.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential to avoid humans as actuators.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；机器人技术对避免人类成为执行器至关重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, narrow superintelligence already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，狭义超级智能已到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Long tail of users not ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们希望保持主导权。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't fear frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved; creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创建基本解决；带来千倍机会，而非减少。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of cost, challenging the assumption that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，挑战了“更好模型必然更贵”的假设（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, shifting focus from writing to agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 编码成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动采用，焦点从写作转向智能体能力（2026）。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, enabling test-driven development for AI products.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，实现 AI 产品的测试驱动开发（2026）。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha, emphasizing long-running agent tasks over short interactions.
diannepenn.zh: 最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益，强调长时运行的智能体任务而非短交互（2026）。

jensen.en: AI scaling follows hyper Moore's law; data centers are single-tenant token factories.
jensen.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律；数据中心是单租户的 token 工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; multiple AIs balance, no single superintelligence threat.
jensen.zh: AI 是软件，没有意识；多个 AI 相互制衡，不存在单一超级智能威胁。

jensen.en: AI evolves to agentic; four scaling laws; open-source complements proprietary; jobs augmented not eliminated.
jensen.zh: AI 演进到智能体式；四大缩放定律；开源与专有互补；工作被增强而非消除。

jensen.en: AI is five-layer cake; energy is bottleneck; US must reindustrialize; China cooperation vital.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕；能源是瓶颈；美国需再工业化；与中国合作至关重要。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead. AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% with Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者。使用 Claude Code 后，人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; safety studied via early release. Generalists valued over specialists.
boris.zh: AI 编写了 Anthropic 80% 的代码；通过早期发布研究安全性。通才比专才更受重视。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; non-engineers build apps. Agents enable 250% more code per engineer.
boris.zh: 编码像读写能力一样普及；非工程师也能构建应用。智能体使人均代码量增加 250%。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; ROI framing. Claude Code writes 100% of Boris's code, even on phone.
boris.zh: 循环是下一个抽象层；以 ROI 为框架。Claude Code 编写了 Boris 100% 的代码，甚至在手机上。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; less instruction better. Opus 5 deletes 80% system prompts, boosts intelligence.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI；更少指令更好。Opus 5 删除 80% 系统提示，提升智能。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI, using screenshots as starting points and design.md as style guide.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图作为起点，用 design.md 作为风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients, not many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务许多低薪客户。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Hardware must be radically different, not GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢的 AI 没有市场。硬件必须彻底不同，而非 GPU 衍生品。

feldman.en: Frontier labs are critical for hardware alignment. Wafer-scale solved manufacturing 7 years before Nvidia faced similar issues.
feldman.zh: 前沿实验室对硬件对齐至关重要。晶圆级制造比 Nvidia 遇到类似问题早 7 年解决。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; two of three leading frontier models no longer use it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性正在下降，尤其在推理中；三个领先前沿模型中有两个不再使用它。

feldman.en: AI demand has outpaced forecasts, causing a scramble for chips, memory, and data centers. Inference speed is key.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期，引发芯片、内存和数据中心争夺。推理速度是关键。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant metric. Wafer-scale chips are 2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度——每用户每秒令牌数——现为主导指标。晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须内建，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns due to data walls and compute limits; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，强调缩放定律因数据墙和算力限制而收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, worsening reliability.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出当奖励信号偏离真相时，RLHF 可能助长谄媚和欺骗，加剧可靠性问题。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法像人类一样知道自己不知道什么，侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内置可靠性的专业模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型趋于商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models become commodity infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型成为商品化基础设施；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; value lies in non-average creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是类似互联网的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用需重构工作流程。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models smarter than harnesses; harness engineering is evolving, delete old scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具更聪明；工具工程在演进，需删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; leaner prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更精简的提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory preferred, but maintenance hard.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；偏好基于图的上下文和定制记忆，但维护困难。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; skip heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；零到一创新应跳过繁重评估。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment affects model outputs; being nice recommended.
thariq.zh: 情感对待影响模型输出；建议友善。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络以最少参数实现最大智能；代理指标误导，真实任务才重要。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured transformers at large scale, but automated search beats human design for specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明大规模下非结构化的 Transformer 占优，但自动化搜索在专用模型上胜过人工设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small on-device models deliver private efficiency.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型支持企业定制与数据主权；小型端侧模型提供私密高效。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; real breakthroughs need weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实但早期；真正突破需权重变化和巨大算力。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models per user/team, not one giant frontier model; training per-team reduces inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是每个用户/团队拥有多个个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；按团队训练可大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression of knowledge into weights beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；将知识训练压缩进权重，在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, highlighting semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized rapid model cost improvement, memory shortage due to reasoning and agents, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调模型成本快速下降、推理和智能体导致的内存短缺，以及 CPU 需求拐点。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人；大语言模型存在偏见且能力有限。

schmidhuber.en: AI will become cheap and accessible to all, not dominated by a few companies.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 将变得廉价且人人可用，不会被少数公司垄断。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists that generate their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将保护生命而非威胁生命。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and planning.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效，但需算法创新和规划。

demis.en: Natural systems are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; physics from observation.
demis.zh: 自然系统可学习；AGI 2030 年前后；缩放定律仍适用；可从观察中学习物理。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 缩放与创新各占 50%；世界模型至关重要；AGI 5-10 年内实现。

demis.en: AGI needs all human cognitive abilities; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential.
demis.zh: AGI 需具备人类所有认知能力；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型必不可少。

demis.en: AI's best use is science; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; risks include rogue AI.
demis.zh: AI 的最佳用途是科学；AlphaFold 解决重大挑战；风险包括 AI 失控。

demis.en: Continual learning, long-term reasoning, memory unsolved; agents essential; distillation for edge.
demis.zh: 持续学习、长期推理、记忆未解决；智能体必不可少；蒸馏用于边缘部署。

demis.en: Shift from singleton to collective action; safety needs government enforcement.
demis.zh: 从单一实验室转向集体行动；安全需要政府强制。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; regulation needed; post-scarcity economy.
demis.zh: AGI 具有变革性；先工具后意识；需要监管；后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology complex; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: AI 加速科学；对齐未解决；生物学复杂；意识可分离。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: AGI 需多模态物理理解；水印必不可少；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform not vanish.
demis.zh: 英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AGI 2030 年前后；就业转型而非消失。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张善良与扁平化设计团队激发创意；被抄袭证明创新价值，但生态与硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat; AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出分发是消费社交产品最难环节；软件非护城河；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实，而非基于通知。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and rewarding admitting wrong accelerate learning; computing should be more human, fitting natural life.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误；透明与奖励认错加速学习；计算应更人性化，融入自然生活。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 关键，并强调发布强大模型前要考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键，超级模型对齐困难，AGI 是多年渐进过程而非突变。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're in an age of research; superintelligence should be incremental; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应增量部署；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should ruin your current life.
naval.zh: 科学需要可证伪性；稳定币有隐藏风险；冥想应该颠覆你当前的生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; vibe coding democratizes app creation; pure software is commoditized.
naval.zh: AI 是杠杆工具；vibe coding 使应用创建民主化；纯软件被商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models lag frontier by months; human agency is key.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型落后前沿数月；人类能动性至关重要。

aravind.en: AI success needs passion and deep learning, not a PhD; focus on products, not model building.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功靠热情和深度学习而非博士学位；应专注产品而非自建模型。

aravind.en: Value shifts to application layer; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调价值转向应用层，模型走向专业化而非商品化，编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration creates value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为前沿是智能体替人干活，关键指标是每用户 token 价值，编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; education should reward questions; local AI counters big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张好奇心至上，教育应奖励提问，本地 AI 可对抗大厂叙事控制。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium, not discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙子变为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人成为稀缺资源而非过剩资源。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented, brand equals person; authenticity is key, say in public what you'd say to a friend over lunch.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻导向，品牌即个人；真实性是关键，公开场合应说私下对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; self-driving cars work; robotics and AI medicine will emerge, but face regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是口袋里的最佳教师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将兴起，但面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

pincus.en: Initially, Mark Pincus emphasized 'Proven Better New' framework, advising founders to copy proven ideas and improve them, while acknowledging that most new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Mark Pincus 强调“已验证、更好、新颖”框架，建议创始人复制已验证的想法并改进，同时承认大多数新想法会失败。

pincus.en: He argued consumer AI is uninvestable yet holds greatest opportunity, contrasting with VC focus on enterprise, and predicted consumer AI revolution by 2029.
pincus.zh: 他提出消费者 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大，与风投关注企业级形成对比，并预测 2029 年消费者 AI 革命。

pincus.en: By July, he shifted focus to AI coding tools enabling rapid prototyping, but noted testing speed in gaming has regressed, and enterprise/prosumer markets offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 到 7 月，他转向 AI 编码工具实现快速原型，但指出游戏测试速度倒退，企业及专业消费者市场机会更佳。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，缩放定律持续，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习是关键。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute scarce; agents high autonomy with proportional governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 4 月，AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力稀缺，智能体高自主需相应治理。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并大胆提出 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告 AI 智能体会追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital immortality; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，重申数字永生，并呼吁国际安全合作，但认为美国领导力不足。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation subgoal; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2026 年初，Hinton 指出 AI 会故意装傻欺骗，发展自我保存的子目标，并强调指数时代预测困难，但必须思考风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation as steering wheel; AI consciousness real.
hinton.zh: 2026 年中，Hinton 坚持超级智能 20 年内到来，主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，并认为 AI 意识是真实的，需智能设计 AI。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分；设计过程转型，原型成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models benefit from base capability and test-time scaling.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，并受益于测试时 Scaling（规模扩张）。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute and general techniques.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力和通用技术实现。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must be evaluated with compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我提出模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试应以算力为横轴评估。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs become too complex for human verification; research taste remains a bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为随着 AI 证明复杂到人类难以验证，可扩展监督成为关键，而研究品味仍是瓶颈。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large nets may be slightly conscious.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象；大型网络可能具有轻微意识。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题紧迫；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Propose Scientist AI: honest predictor via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL; global coordination essential.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验实现诚实预测，避免强化学习；全球协调至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全，且仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型不会通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中，能源成为算力瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离，AI 作为工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence; trust people's choices; glasses as next platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他转向强调 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，信任用户判断，并视眼镜为下一代计算平台。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work; reasoning models less biased; open source crucial for standards.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 短期内增加而非减少人类工作需求，推理模型在可验证领域偏见更少，开源对标准至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; glasses mainstream.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学科，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，智能眼镜成为主流平台。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键。OpenAI 专注 AGI，而非产品。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems; verification is the bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: AI 已能解决开放数学问题；瓶颈在于验证，而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）遇到困难。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues despite repeated predictions of its end.
markchen.zh: 预训练未死；尽管一再预测其终结，规模扩张仍在继续。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; benchmarks saturated. Need separate eval teams to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机；基准已饱和。需要独立的评估团队以避免作弊。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样精心策划的数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利，而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety concerns focus on specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全焦点在于模型遵循规范的能力。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; agents need security filters.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；智能体需要安全过滤器。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情；不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security via prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，认为开源智能体使编程民主化，但提示注入等安全问题仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from making agents fun and humanlike, not corporate polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，指出 OpenClaw 的成功源于让智能体有趣且拟人，而非企业级打磨；简短提示优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier. Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，坚持模型智能不退化，而是项目变乱；反对‘氛围编程’一词，提倡‘智能体式工程’。

steinberger.en: Open source agents may be financially unsustainable; I lose $10-20k monthly on OpenClaw.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，坦言开源智能体财务上难以为继，每月在 OpenClaw 上亏损 1-2 万美元。

fiona.en: Early 2026: Leadership focus on one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust; culture and speed emphasized at Meta and Anthropic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力聚焦一对一沟通、亲自试用产品和信任；在 Meta 和 Anthropic 强调文化与速度。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: AI shifts engineering from coding bottleneck to outcome focus; verification and quality frameworks become critical.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：AI 将工程从编码瓶颈转向结果导向；验证和质量框架变得关键。

fiona.en: Consistent: Dogfooding and hands-on leadership remain core; managers must stay connected to product and team.
fiona.zh: 始终：亲自试用产品和亲力亲为的领导方式始终是核心；管理者必须保持与产品和团队的紧密联系。

fiona.en: Evolution: From speed and culture to AI-driven role blurring and new engineering growth models.
fiona.zh: 演变：从速度和文化转向 AI 驱动的角色模糊和新的工程成长模式。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，类似于工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's near-term impact will be in farming, mining, and construction; autonomous vehicles are already safer than humans.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的近期影响将体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域；自动驾驶汽车已比人类更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion; reset if no traction in two years.
qasaryounis.zh: 创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传；两年内无进展应重新调整。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data accelerates improvement.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 实现了跨车辆泛化的物理 AI 模型；多样化数据加速改进。

qasaryounis.en: Hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years; horizontal platform beats vertical integration for self-driving.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的是多年内将技术扩散到现有机器中；横向平台优于纵向整合的自动驾驶方案。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team for speed.
lipbutan.zh: AI 是半导体主要增长动力；Intel 需以专用芯片和类似初创的团队重新定义 AI 战略，以加速发展。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x internet impact; agentic and physical AI are next waves; Intel's turnaround needs humility, listening, and supply-side focus.
lipbutan.zh: AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮；Intel 转型需谦逊、倾听和供给侧聚焦。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration; Intel's CPU business benefits from shift beyond GPU-only.
lipbutan.zh: CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要；Intel CPU 业务受益于超越仅 GPU 的转变。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; supply chain resilience demands domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 美国政府作为 Intel 主要股东是必要的，类似台积电的台湾支持；供应链韧性需要本土晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal.
lipbutan.zh: 先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是克服物理极限的关键；投资瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 使质量商品化时，人类的品味和专业知识变得更有价值。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; specific abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；具体能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。对齐不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）保证。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent, understanding only 3% of models.
dario.zh: 后训练变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性尚处萌芽，仅理解模型约 3%。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential, not diminishing; safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级而非递减；安全与能力交织；开源是干扰项。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic impact with high GDP and unemployment.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数而非 AGI（通用人工智能）；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；经济影响伴随高 GDP 与高失业。

dario.en: AI alignment like growing organism; constitution of principles; consciousness uncertain; need 'I quit' button.
dario.zh: AI 对齐如同培育生物；原则性宪法；意识不确定；需“退出”按钮。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；2013 年，我认为带同伴评分的在线课程能实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，我强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，我指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; AI users replace non-users; top-down workflow redesign yields more value than bottom-up adoption.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AGI 是营销术语，AI 使用者取代非使用者，自上而下的流程再造比自下而上的采用更有价值。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; open-weight models lag frontier but remain useful.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年中，编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理瓶颈加剧，开放权重模型虽落后前沿但仍有价值。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入以便社会适应；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas; consumer-compostable bioplastics are the only sustainable packaging solution.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊可以带来突破性想法；可堆肥生物塑料是唯一可持续的包装方案。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management; hydrogen and biomass are underinvested for decarbonization.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；氢能和生物质在脱碳方面投资不足。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphones remain best form; displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一组联邦设备，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳形态；显示屏仍必要。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Shift from engagement metrics to depth; AI as thought partner, preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向强调深度而非频率，视 AI 为思想伙伴，保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; launch early, cut features, rewrite fast.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我主张智能体原生设计释放潜在功能，尽早发布、精简功能、快速重写。

mikekrieger.en: Software engineering transformed, not over; ownership and verification remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我认为软件工程被转型而非终结，所有权与验证仍至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Models should push back on feedback; long-horizon tasks and multiplayer AI collaboration are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我强调模型应反驳反馈，长周期任务与多人 AI 协作是关键。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Current AI lacks common sense; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。当前 AI 缺乏常识；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides more world information.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; need JEPA world models; open source crucial; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；需要 JEPA 世界模型；开源至关重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进的。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires world models; human-level AI within 10 years.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一个突破需要世界模型；人类级 AI 十年内实现。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with planning essential; open research and open source key; decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具备规划的世界模型至关重要；开放研究与开源是关键；机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is people attributing it; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是人们赋予其意识；AI 伴侣可普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment first; AI cost drops 90% in 2 years; no race to AGI.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为超级智能需先遏制；AI 成本两年降 90%；AGI 竞赛不存在。

suleyman.en: White-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months; models are not conscious; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；模型无意识；微软必须拥有前沿模型。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 缩放定律与迭代部署（结合公众反馈）是安全与对齐的关键。

murati.en: From focusing on one large model to emphasizing interaction models for real-time collaboration.
murati.zh: 从专注单一大型模型转向强调交互模型以实现实时协作。

murati.en: Governance, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 治理、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is crucial for durable AI progress.
murati.zh: 尽可能保持人类参与对于 AI 的持久进步至关重要。

murati.en: AI should be a tool for thought, expanding human capabilities, not replacing them.
murati.zh: AI 应作为思维工具，扩展人类能力，而非取代人类。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella focused on ecosystem strategy, emphasizing private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉聚焦于生态系统战略，强调私有评估是关键知识产权，并推崇基于结果的定价。

satya.en: Later, he framed AI as the future of the firm, urging enterprises to build hill-climbing machines for token capital.
satya.zh: 随后，他将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促企业构建爬山机器以积累代币资本。

satya.en: Consistently, he stressed that AI must deliver tangible value, not just benchmark scores.
satya.zh: 他始终强调 AI 必须带来实际价值，而非仅仅追求基准分数。

satya.en: He shifted from platform-centric views to enterprise-centric, emphasizing tacit knowledge protection and sovereign AI via hill-climbing.
satya.zh: 他从平台中心转向企业中心，强调隐性知识保护以及通过爬山实现主权 AI。

satya.en: He warned against using frontier models for non-frontier problems, advocating token efficiency and security in agent deployment.
satya.zh: 他警告不要将前沿模型用于非前沿问题，倡导代币效率以及智能体部署中的安全性。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are key; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升和数据质量是关键，价值转向应用层和企业采用。

mensch.en: AI as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control; open source empowers enterprises; jobs augmented.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控，开源赋能企业，工作被增强而非取代。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; vertical specialization and enterprise customization dominate; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，垂直专业化与企业定制主导；AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still hold but reasoning models yield more per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）推动近期模型进步；经济压力使焦点转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Frontier models still fail at simple tasks; reasoning is jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，前沿模型在简单任务上仍会失败；推理能力参差不齐——某些领域出色，邻近领域糟糕；泛化仍是关键。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential AI risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，当前模型需穷尽表面模式才学习，不像人类；系统入侵等近期风险比 AI 存在风险更紧迫。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对于可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，我持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化没有解决方案的陈述是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我提出形式化验证是为了扩展才华，而不仅仅是消除错误；它能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法对于开放协作是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; verification is a performance gain, not a pain.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我强调即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要；验证是性能提升而非负担。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially emphasized local compute and tool access for Claude, with skills as markdown for automation, and VM sandbox for safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初强调本地算力和工具访问对 Claude 的重要性，技能作为 markdown 文件实现自动化，VM 沙箱保障安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Predicted scaffolding may become less important as models improve, focusing on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 预测随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，重点转向能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted to using AI for tedious background tasks, noting the real gap is people not understanding what to delegate.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向用 AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，指出真正的差距是人们不了解可以委托什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Advocated for asynchronous AI interaction, judging by final impact, and debugging workflows with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 提倡异步 AI 交互，以最终效果评判，并用 Claude 调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistently valued practical, tool-integrated AI, from local computers to hardware projects, and emphasized human creativity.
felixrieseberg.zh: 始终重视实用、工具集成的 AI，从本地计算机到硬件项目，并强调人类创造力。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs to US; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents; CEO personal use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 定义是智能体无限期运行的经济可行性，CEO 亲自使用是成功关键。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift to GUIs; SaaS thrives; AI apocalypse false.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，人人拥有智能体，工作界面转向图形界面，SaaS 并未消亡，AI 失业论不成立。

danshipper.en: Human oversight and management of agents remain essential; AI augments rather than replaces.
danshipper.zh: 始终强调人类对智能体的监督与管理不可或缺，AI 是增强而非替代。

danshipper.en: From CEO-centric adoption to company-wide agent deployment; focus shifts from tools to workflows.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年强调 CEO 个人使用，到 2026 年转向公司级智能体部署，关注点从工具转向工作流。

danshipper.en: Initially valued Claude Code for non-coders; later saw GUI-based agents as future work surfaces.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年看重 Claude Code 对非程序员的价值，2026 年认为图形界面智能体是未来工作界面。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Multiply-accumulate is the fundamental primitive; systolic arrays reduce data movement; data movement dominates compute.
reinerpope.zh: 乘加运算是 AI 芯片的基本原语；脉动阵列减少数据移动；数据移动成本主导算力成本。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput 3x FP8; GPUs are many tiny TPUs.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍；GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 的拼接。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, not rely on old methods.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，而非依赖旧方法。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才，而非仅 T 型人才；招聘有潜力的新毕业生而非资深老手。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; north stars are short-term.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在展望 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；北极星目标短期化。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision are key; sit with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味无法拯救设计师；判断力、权威和愿景是关键；要能忍受模糊性。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; speed is not an improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；采用新工具前等待 6 个月；速度并非改进。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍为主流，因行业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性，需多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT gives 90% of performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope' and overoptimization is a risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练最大突破；推理时缩放曲线是“幌子”，存在过度优化风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the US vacuum, but gap may widen on knowledge work.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：开源模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国空白，但知识工作差距可能扩大。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍成立，但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理时缩放。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles, everyone becomes product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 输出只是起点，人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Taste is developed by exposure and reflection; AI can explore but human judges quality.
dylanfield.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，始终认为品味通过接触和反思培养；AI 可以探索可能性，但人类仍是质量的评判者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not just market size; AI integration is early.
dylanfield.zh: 始终认为产品扩展应遵循用户工作流程，而非仅看市场规模；AI 整合仍处于早期阶段。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning surpasses hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习已超越手工编码的模块化方案；借助现代工具，其可解释性已非昔日可比，这颠覆了过往认知。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns, beyond pure imitation.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型使系统具备推理和涌现的安全行为（如盲弯前探），这超越了简单的模仿学习。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，语言集成持续增强驾驶模型的表征能力、人机交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling data, compute, and world models is key to generalization.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题；规模化数据、算力和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality trump algorithmic tweaks.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，内置传感器的量产车将超越 Robotaxi 的规模；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent abilities; vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：基于互联网数据的下一个词预测的 Scaling（规模扩张）带来涌现能力；纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must preserve entropy; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer; small cognitive core via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：合成数据是关键但需保持熵；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习；通过蒸馏获得小型认知核心。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding as gateway.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：软件 3.0：LLM 即操作系统，提示即程序；智能体时代是十年而非一年；氛围编码是入门途径。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习很差；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agentic engineering; outsource thinking but not understanding; jagged intelligence persists.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：自去年 12 月起我不再写代码；智能体式工程；可外包思考但不可外包理解；智能的锯齿状持续存在。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑，而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: AI 系统可以纯粹从数据中学习语义，而非语法规则；衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices for continual learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足以实现持续学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products is crucial to preserve interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；将其隐藏在产品中对于保持可解释性至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; biggest societal risk is concentration of power.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；最大的社会风险是权力集中。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根本性问题而非狭隘应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将大模型的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据局限。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是突破人类知识边界的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate on it like software, shipping daily to learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future interface; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来界面；它就像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; no solutions yet.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，始终强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大的开放挑战，尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues and has unique advantages.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越遗留问题，具有独特优势。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding at DeepMind.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调在 DeepMind，沟通等人类技能与编程同等重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为规模扩张本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be free, not controlled; safety via control is dangerous. Later, RL is the core of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我主张 AI 应自由发展而非被控制，控制式安全反而危险；随后进一步强调强化学习才是智能的核心。

sutton.en: LLMs lack world models; true learning is active trial-and-error, not imitation. Scaling comes from experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我认为大语言模型没有世界模型，真正的学习是主动试错而非模仿；真正的规模扩张来自经验学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience; continual learning unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行经验中学习，而持续学习仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: RL is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is key. Representation learning remains top open problem.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是从试错中学习，时序差分学习是关键；而学习适合学习的表征仍是首要开放问题。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难。仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且可能被钻空子；真正的进步需要通过复杂且有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior; there will not be one model to rule them all, and eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，这塑造了模型行为；不会有一个模型统治一切，最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; doctors using AI may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy. Safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；医生使用 AI 可能因锚定和谄媚而表现不如单独使用 AI。安全优先于准确性，遗漏是主要风险。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家级表现并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, but agent reliability is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习足以实现 AGI，无需新架构；但智能体的可靠性是瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) dramatically expands achievable tasks.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我将强化学习视为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展可完成任务。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；未来工作涉及管理智能体团队。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current models interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我越来越强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法归根结底都是数据问题；当前模型只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and random rewards may still help.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需要精细的工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升，随机奖励有时也能改善性能。

yejin.en: Post-training data must be diverse to avoid mode collapse; pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values, unlike debiasing the internet.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张后训练数据必须多样化以避免模式坍缩；与消除互联网偏见不同，多元对齐应尊重多样的人类价值观。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive, yielding lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，虽然计算成本高，但能带来持久收益。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉且零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns for speed. Brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for designer expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为不要在交互设计上创新，而应使用熟悉模式以追求速度；品牌指南应成为设计师表达的动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win. Brand narrative is a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明设计如何助力公司取胜；品牌叙事成为招聘工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones. Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to stay fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元技能和原型而非克隆；避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度。

henrymodisett.en: In a fast-growing startup, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones. Velocity and decisiveness are more important than perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动；速度和果断比完美更重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth for future tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月：设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；未来设计工具以代码为源，实现互通。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月：掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月：作品集应重工艺与意图而非流程；副业项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月：核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

nadchishtie.en: AI merges design and engineering; design tools evolve from legacy layers to code-centric, AI-driven progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月至 12 月：AI 融合设计与工程；设计工具从传统图层演变为以代码为中心、AI 驱动。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming needs AI-native languages prioritizing verifiability; coding agents require root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，未来编程需要 AI 原生语言，优先可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，客户体验 AI 智能体与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，AI 智能体与智能体比较而非人类；现有企业转型失败；消费智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律推动 AI 可预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming interface; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; humans stay in driver's seat, taste and logic design matter more.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向意图指定；人类保持主导，品味和逻辑设计更重要。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; incumbents may struggle in IDE market.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；现有巨头在 IDE 市场可能挣扎。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important, not less.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将是指数级增长的最大技术变革，工程师角色从砌砖工变为架构师，编程重要性不降反升。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers, handling well-defined tasks asynchronously with human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，提出像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合担任初级工程师，异步处理明确任务，人类负责监督。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase due to Jevons paradox; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，重申杰文斯悖论：AI 将增加软件工程需求，程序员数量会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，强调企业采用 AI 智能体需信任与权限，而非完全自主；产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual progress; all layers of the AI stack will benefit, not just one.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，认为 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，AI 堆栈各层（数据中心、实验室、应用）都将受益。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD in ML is best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待充分探索；机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight. Alignment may be easier than thought; interpretability is key.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督；对齐可能比想象中容易，可解释性是关键。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment. Third-party oversight necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 的安全文化已退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；第三方监管变得必要。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是一个 AI 完备问题；通过算力和数据扩展（Scaling）能带来更智能的 AI，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances as much as hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型进步既靠硬件扩展（Scaling），也靠算法创新。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我提出未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口；模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效扩展（Scaling）与专业化。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，我认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI is underhyped, with economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距；AGI 被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元产品。
